result_semantic_payload.summary: The recorded evidence does NOT support the analyst's statement that "the customer database was copied to a removable drive on 2025-03-08." The claim is unsupported on every element: (a) the platform is not Windows — get_task_context reports platforms:[] and source_scopes:[], so no Windows registry, event-log, Prefetch, Amcache, or USN data exists in scope despite the 'windows' delegation label; (b) the file inventory contains only 5 small files (README.md 83 B, /data/客户清单.csv 136 B, /data/入金记录.txt 142 B, /话术/开场白.txt 251 B, /话术/应对拒绝.txt 166 B) — none is plausibly a customer database, and 客户清单.csv is a 136-byte CSV list, not a database; (c) no removable-media path, volume, drive-letter, USB device, or Eject/USBSTOR event appears anywhere; (d) the entire timeline is 10 events confined to two single-second windows — MODIFIED at unix 1789924915 and CREATED at unix 1789924922 — which convert to 2026-09-21, not 2025-03-08, so no event falls on the alleged date; (e) the only timeline activity is FILE_CREATED / FILE_MODIFIED on the same 5 files in the image's own root paths — there is no COPY, WRITE-to-removable, or egress event, and the CREATED timestamps are only 7 seconds after the MODIFIED timestamps, consistent with a single bulk image-population pass rather than a copy operation; (f) no deleted files exist. The records therefore refute the analyst's statement as to date, as to medium, and as to the nature of the object; they support only the weaker finding that a small set of Chinese-language business files (a customer list, an incoming-funds log, and sales-pitch scripts) exists in the image and was written in one ~7-second window on 2026-09-21.

claim_candidates.text: The evidence base contains no Windows-derived artifacts: get_task_context reports platforms:[] and source_scopes:[], so no registry, event-log, Prefetch, Amcache, or USN Journal data is available despite the 'windows' source-scope label on the delegation.

The image contains only 5 files totalling 788 bytes (README.md 83 B, /data/客户清单.csv 136 B, /data/入金记录.txt 142 B, /话术/开场白.txt 251 B, /话术/应对拒绝.txt 166 B); none has the size or type of a customer database, and 客户清单.csv is a 136-byte CSV, not a database.
No removable-media indicator exists in the records: no drive letter, volume, USB/USBSTOR/Eject event, or removable path appears in the file inventory or in any of the 10 timeline events.

The full timeline consists of 10 events in two single-second windows: MODIFIED at unix 1789924915 and CREATED at unix 1789924922, which convert to 2026-09-21 — not 2025-03-08. No event falls on the alleged date, so the date element of the analyst's statement is refuted.

The only recorded activity is FILE_CREATED / FILE_MODIFIED on the same 5 files, with CREATED timestamps only 7 seconds after MODIFIED timestamps; this pattern is consistent with a single bulk image-population pass and does not constitute a copy-to-removable event.
The analyst's statement is unsupported as to date, as to medium, and as to the nature of the object; it cannot be affirmed from the recorded evidence.
No deleted files are present in the image, so no evidence of a subsequent deletion of a copied database copy is available.

limitations: get_task_context reports platforms:[] and source_scopes:[] — the 'windows' source scope named in the delegation is not backed by any registered scenario, so Windows-specific evidence (registry, event logs, Prefetch, Amcache, USN Journal) is absent from the read-only tool surface.
All 5 files return content_preview:null, so only names, sizes, inodes, and metadata are observable; file contents could not be inspected to confirm or deny database structure.
No md5 values are populated for any file, so content-based correlation with an alleged external 'customer database' is not possible.
Timestamps are given only as unix seconds; the 2025-03-08 vs 2026-09-21 conversion is derived from the unix values 1789924915 / 1789924922 and assumes UTC interpretation.

The timeline contains only 10 events in two 1-second windows; absence of a copy event on 2025-03-08 is a finding of absence within this bounded record set, not proof that no such event occurred on the original host.
warnings: Platform/source-scope mismatch: delegation says 'windows' but task metadata exposes no platform and no source scopes — the analyst's Windows-flavored claim cannot be evaluated against Windows evidence because none is present.
The analyst's date (2025-03-08) is outside the entire recorded timeline (which is confined to 2026-09-21); the claim is refuted as to date by the full event set.
No removable-media indicator of any kind appears in the file inventory or timeline, so the 'removable drive' element is unsupported.
The alleged 'customer database' does not appear to exist as an artifact: the closest candidate is 客户清单.csv at 136 bytes, which is a CSV list, not a database.
